biggest_catch: Must open through the campus promotional page (or an eligible campus branch with banker activation) — applying from any other page forfeits the offer; also requires $1,000 in new-money deposits, a meaningful bar for students.
catches: Must open online through the U.S. Bank campus promotional page (or an eligible campus branch with banker activation) — applying from any other page voids the offer.
New U.S. Bank consumer checking customers only; no existing checking account, none closed in the last 12 months, no other U.S. Bank checking bonus in the past 12 months.

Requires $1,000 or more in total new-money deposits (funds from outside U.S. Bank) plus 10+ debit card purchases totaling $100+ and online/mobile banking enrollment — all within 90 days of account opening.

Bonus ('adjusted interest') credited within 60 days following the end of the calendar month in which all requirements were completed — a slow payout.

steps: Open a new U.S. Bank Smartly Checking account online through the campus promotional page (or at an eligible campus branch) between May 5, 2026 and October 29, 2026, with a $25 minimum deposit.

Within 90 days of account opening: make $1,000 or more in total new-money deposits (from outside U.S. Bank), complete 10 or more debit card purchases totaling $100 or more, and enroll in online or mobile banking.
The $100 checking bonus is credited within 60 days following the end of the calendar month in which all requirements were completed; keep the account open with a positive balance until payout.
timing: Open by October 29, 2026; complete all steps within 90 days of account opening; bonus credited within 60 days following the end of the calendar month requirements were completed.
